config.magazine_casing.enableMagazineDro: If true, reloading a magazine-fed gun from empty spawns a dropped magazine entity.
config.magazine_casing.magazineDespawnTi: How many ticks a dropped magazine stays in the world before despawning (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.magazine_casing.magazineDropBlack: Gun IDs that must never drop a magazine on empty reload.
config.magazine_casing.magazineModelRepl: Each entry maps an original gun to a model source gun using "originalGun|modelSourceGun".
config.magazine_casing.casingDespawnTick: How many ticks a dropped shell casing stays in the world before despawning (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.magazine_casing.maxCasingCount.de: Maximum number of shell casing entities that can exist at once.
Master switch: whether firing ejects a shell casing entity.
config.magazine_casing.casingDropBlackli: Gun IDs that must not eject a shell casing when firing.
config.magazine_casing.reloadCasingDrops: Guns that eject shell casings on reload, using "gunId|count".
